description: How to reach one person: their email address, phone number where there is one, and their profile links. Give a name — add their employer if the name is a common one — and you get back the person, their current role, and the ways to contact them. Use it when someone says "how do I get hold of her", "find his email", "I need to reach the person who runs marketing there". Do not use it to find out WHO to contact: this looks up somebody you can already name. If the name matches more than one person you get the list of candidates and nothing is charged; pick one and ask again. Nothing is charged when nobody matches either. Costs 5 credits when it finds them.

company.description: Optional. Where they work, as a name or website (for example "Acme" or acme.com), so a common name finds the right person.

name.description: The full name of the person, for example "Jane Doe". Give either name or person_id.

person_id.description: The id of one person from the candidate list an earlier call returned, when the name matched several people. Give either name or person_id.

name: enrich_person

candidates.description: People or companies the name could mean, each with an id and enough to tell them apart. Nothing is charged for this list.

credits_charged.description: Credits this call took. 0 when nothing was charged.

emails.description: Email addresses that are confirmed or published, each with its status.

error.description: Present when the call could not do the work; says why and that nothing was charged where that is so.

message.description: A plain note about the answer, for example why candidates were returned instead of a result.

phones.description: Phone numbers, where there are any.

pricing_note.description: What this call cost and what a repeat costs.

retry_with_param.description: The input to send on the next call with the chosen candidate.

status.description: "needs_disambiguation" when the name matched more than one person; pick one and call again with its person_id.

summary.description: A one-paragraph summary of who they are.

title: Person's contact details
